H_SHUFFLE_MEMORIZATION.hypothesis: [H1] 2-layer head with 14,560 params memorizes shuffled training labels (margin > 1.5).

H_SHUFFLE_TEST_COLLAPSE.hypothesis: [H2] Shuffled head collapses to chance on held-out test data (margin <= 0.15, acc ~= 50%).

H_TRUE_GENERALIZATION.hypothesis: [H3] True-label head maintains significant expansion on held-out test takes (margin > 1.0).

H_SESSION_CONFOUND.hypothesis: [H4] When train and test share session recording channels, test expansion reflects channel-correlated signal.
H_SESSION_CONFOUND.status: VALIDATED_BY_DESIGN (every slice traces to single recording memo per speaker)

reverb.physical_mechanism: Late reflections smear formant transitions; energy blurs across orthogonal spectral modes.
reverb.hypothesis: [H-REVERB] T60 > 0.4s drops test margin by >= 50% from baseline.
reverb.falsifiable_test: Simulated RIR convolution with T60 in [0.4, 0.8]s.

codec.physical_mechanism: Band-limiting, MDCT quantization, and psychoacoustic spectral hole filling distort fine formants.
codec.hypothesis: [H-CODEC] Low-bitrate codec transcoding drops test margin by >= 40%.
codec.falsifiable_test: Transcoding through ffmpeg libopus at 16 kbps.

overlap.failure_mode: Overlapping Speech in Enrollment Slice (SIR <= 6 dB)
overlap.physical_mechanism: Interferer leakage pulls enrollment prototype into intermediate ambiguous region.
overlap.hypothesis: [H-OVERLAP] Enrollment SIR <= 6 dB causes margin collapse >= 40% and elevated false accepts.
overlap.falsifiable_test: Synthetic addition of interfering voice at 0 to 6 dB SIR.

pitch.failure_mode: Pitch Shift / Prosodic Drift (Delta F0 >= +-4 semitones)
pitch.physical_mechanism: Harmonic grid shifts outside frequency-band coordinates learned by head.
pitch.hypothesis: [H-PITCH] Pitch shifting by +-4 semitones causes margin drop >= 40%.
pitch.falsifiable_test: PSOLA or sox pitch shift by +-4 semitones.

whisper.physical_mechanism: Absence of harmonic glottal comb; excitation is turbulent aspiration noise; F1/F2 formants shift upward.
whisper.hypothesis: [H-WHISPER] Whispered speech collapses margin below 0.25 and margin drops >= 70%.
whisper.falsifiable_test: Acoustic recording of whispered speech evaluated against modal-voice profile.
